title: Bundle Metadata
description: Schema for bundle_metadata.json — partner-provided metadata about the delegation template and permission boundary.

partner_domain.description: The partner's registered domain in the IAM temporary delegation system (e.g., 'example-partner.com', 'monitoring-vendor.com'). Used to construct the full permission boundary ARN: arn:aws:iam::partner:policy/permissions-boundary/<partner_domain>/<boundary_name>

template_name.description: Name of the permission template as registered with IAM.

template_description.description: Description of what the permission template grants and its intended use case.

boundary_name.description: Name of the permission boundary as registered with IAM. Must end with a date suffix (_YYYY_MM_DD). Required if a boundary is included in the bundle.

boundary_description.description: Description of what the permission boundary caps and its intended scope.
